pointer.content:
Test Case 1: Docker Image Built with Latest Code

Input: Check if devbob:1.0.64 image exists locally

Expected Output:
{
  "imageExists": true,
  "imageTag": "devbob:1.0.64",
  "builtAfterCommits": true
}

Validation Logic:
- Run: docker images devbob:1.0.64
- Verify image exists
- Check build timestamp is recent (< 3 days old)
- Ensure image was built after storage commits (ef0d29c, d414213, e6a096b)

Pass Criteria:
- Image exists locally
- Image tag matches devbob:1.0.64
- Built within last 3 days (indicating it includes latest code)
